title: PaMCP Publication Visualization Plan
policy: Visualization contracts only; no experiment, hypothesis, dataset, metric, baseline assignment or result status is changed. No placeholder values are experimental observations.

data_conventions.categorical_values: Use exact baseline IDs or exact PaMCP variant names.
data_conventions.ci_columns: ci_low and ci_high are percentile-bootstrap limits for the plotted estimand.
data_conventions.paired_effects: Use a consistent PaMCP-minus-baseline sign and state whether positive is beneficial.
data_conventions.benchmark_tracks: Stratify heterogeneous datasets; do not pool incomparable benchmarks.
